title: Year 11 Investigating Science Module 2 – Cause and Effect – Inferences and Generalisations
description: A fast-recall review of NSW Year 11 Investigating Science Module 2. Questions use short answers and avoid multi-step calculations or extended writing.
author: Generated with Classroom Jeopardy Quiz Maker

questions.prompt: What term describes an explanation drawn from observations?
What term describes a statement that applies a pattern in data more broadly?

What term describes a repeated or consistent feature in data?
What term describes the overall direction shown by a set of data?
What is a data point that lies noticeably away from the overall pattern called?
What term describes seeing a meaningful image or pattern where none was intended?
What can happen when humans see patterns that are not actually present in data?
What testable prediction links variables in an investigation?
What type of question can be answered through scientific investigation?
questions.answer: An inquiry question. Accept: testable question.
